definitions.explanation: Detecting or perceiving something through the senses or through a device. Used both for human perception and for machines or sensors that detect changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{感知|かんち}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧{感知器|かんちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}して→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The smoke detector reacted and the alarm went off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前兆|ぜんちょう}→前兆：09118_zenchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{感知|かんち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Animals are said to have the ability to sense earthquake precursors.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in technical contexts (sensors, detectors, alarms) and also for the innate ability of people or animals to sense things that aren't immediately obvious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感知|かんち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to detect; to sense)
- {感知器|かんちき} (detector; sensor)
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧{感知器|かんちき} (smoke detector)
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{感知|かんち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sense danger)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{検知|けんち}→検知：18762_kenchi⟧: detection — more technical, used for instruments and scientific measurement
- ⟦{察知|さっち}→察知：21208_sacchi⟧: perception; sensing — emphasizes intuiting something through observation or experience
